sentences.text: Present: Mr. Suneel Awasthi, Advocate, for the petitioner.
Mr. Ajit Sharma, Deputy Advocate General, for the respondent.
Notice.
Mr. Ajit Sharma, Learned Deputy Advocate General, appears and waives service of notice on behalf of the respondent.
Let status report be filed in two weeks.

2. The bail petitioner [Rahul] has come up before this Court seeking pre-arrest bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure [hereinafter referred to as 'Cr.P.C.'] originating from FIR No.55, dated 25.03.2024, under Sections 406, 408, 420 & 120-B of the Indian Penal Code [hereinafter referred to as 'IPC], registered at Police Station Damtal, District Kangra [H.P.].
3.
The case set up by Mr. Suneel Awasthi, learned counsel for the petitioner is that the bail petitioner-accused [Rahul] has falsely been roped in the aforesaid accusation.
It is further averred that the bail petitioner has nothing to do with the alleged incident and he is an innocent person.

It is further averred that the bail petitioner has been working .
under the instructions of his superiors and persons responsible for managing the affairs of the company i.e. Swastik Food Products Limited.
It is further averred that there is no evidence to connect the petitioner with the alleged offence and the allegations are false, fabricated and concocted.
It is further averred that the bail petitioner has deep roots in the society and he is a young man of 25 years.

4. It is further averred that the bail petitioner has filed a Bail Application No.89-XXII/2024, before the learned Trial Court i.e. Additional Sessions Judge, Nurpur, District Kangra, which was dismissed on 03.05.2024 [Annexure P-1], primarily, on the ground that transactions are found to have been made in the bank accounts of bail petitioner, his brother and his father as well as other accused persons, namely, Leela Krishan and Gagandeep, who are employees of the Swastik Food Products Limited;
and investigation is underway and his release may threaten the witnesses and hamper the investigation and the custodial interrogation is required.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, Nurpur, District Kangra
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
In this context, Mr. Suneel Awasthi, .
learned counsel for the petitioner, submits that so far as the monetary transactions are concerned the same are to be tested and proved by the prosecution during the trial.
He further submits that the apprehension of the prosecution that the release may hamper the investigation or influence the witnesses can be taken care of by imposing stringent conditions.

sentences.text: The bail petitioner [Rahul] has given the undertakings that he shall participate in the investigation as and when called.

The undertaking has further been furnished that the bail petitioner shall not cause any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case or the witnesses in any manner.
6. The bail petitioner has further averred that he is innocent and has been falsely implicated and he has no connection with the alleged offence.
It is averred that he has o past criminal history and unblemished records.

The involvement or abetting in any offence, shall entail cancellation of pre-arrest bail, automatically;
(ix) It is clarified that violation of any of the conditions imposed hereinabove shall entail cancellation of bail automatically; and (x) The respondent is at liberty to move this Court for modification or cancellation of bail, if circumstances, so necessitate or in case of violation of any of the conditions mandated herein.
